applied.problem: Across the Load stepper's range to 900 kW, an isochronous set cannot take the whole load past its 504 kW; and in this loaded example B's current falls, so the cross current warms A's winding, not both.

Screen 12 says the cross current warms both windings, but B's current falls (357.8 against 375 kVA); the isochronous rule says nothing past 504 kW though the load goes to 900; kVAr settings can drive a set leading or past 630 kVA unmarked.

Raising one setting and lowering the other by the same amount holds the frequency only on equal sets with equal droop; one set's extra fuel also lifts the frequency a little; unlinked isochronous sets can, not always, motor one set.
For a battery string, 'takes more of the current' reads as charging; the higher string gives more of the load current.

notes.problem: The droop rule does not say how a share below zero meets the 50.4 kW motoring draw, nor how f is re-solved when one share hits its 504 kW cap; the build should clamp at −50.4 and 504 kW and re-solve so the shares still add to the load.
